review.tagline: MCP server giving coding agents symbol-level code search, editing and refactoring
review.summary: Serena is an MCP server that gives a coding agent IDE-style tools: find symbol, find references, replace symbol body, rename, and a memory system. It uses language servers (over 40 languages) by default, or a paid JetBrains plugin that adds move, inline, type hierarchy and a debugger. It plugs into MCP clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and VSCode.
review.audience: Developers who want their coding agent to navigate and refactor large codebases
strengths: Symbol-level retrieval and editing instead of line numbers or text search
Language server backend is free and covers over 40 languages
Works with any MCP client, launched by command or run in HTTP mode
Layered YAML configuration: global, per-project, per-client contexts and modes
weaknesses: Move, inline, type hierarchy and debugging need the paid JetBrains plugin
Language server rename covers symbols only; some languages need extra installs
Application is GPL-3.0-or-later; only the SolidLSP component is MIT
needs: Needs uv, language servers (per language), JetBrains IDE plugin (optional, paid)
Models: Any LLM through MCP clients (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini-CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, VSCode, Claude Desktop)
